keyPoints: Dashamlav bindu ke dayen pehla sthan dasvansh (tenths) aur doosra shatansh (hundredths) hota hai — 0.5 ka matlab 5/10 aur 0.75 ka matlab 75/100.
Bhinn ko dashamlav me badalne ke liye ansh me har se bhaag do: 3/4 = 0.75; aur dashamlav ko bhinn me: 0.25 = 25/100 = 1/4.
Tulna ke liye dono sankhyaon me dashamlav ke baad barabar ank banao — 0.5 aur 0.45 me 0.50 > 0.45, isliye 0.5 bada hai.
Jodne-ghatane me dashamlav bindu ek ke neeche ek rakho: 2.5 + 3.75 = 6.25 — bindu ka seedh me hona zaroori hai.
Guna me pehle bindu hata kar guna karo, phir kul dashamlav sthan gin kar bindu lagao: 0.3 x 0.2 = 0.06.
Rozmarra me dashamlav har jagah hai — 2.5 kg aata, 99.50 rupaye, 1.75 metre kapda.
Aam galti: 0.5 ko 0.45 se chhota samajhna — lambai se tulna mat karo, 0.5 = 0.50 jo 0.45 se bada hai.
